question: The inner and outer radius of a hollow hemispherical shell are 14 cm and 28 cm respectively. Find the approximate volume of the metal used. ?
solution:
**Given:**

Inner radius (r) = 14 cm

Outer radius (R) = 28 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of hollow hemisphere = (2 ÷ 3) × π × (R³ − r³)

**Calculations:**

R³ = 28³ = 21952

r³ = 14³ = 2744

⇒ R³ − r³ = 21952 − 2744 = 19208

⇒ Volume = (2 ÷ 3) × (22 ÷ 7) × 19208

⇒ Volume = (2 ÷ 3) × 22 × 2744

⇒ Volume = 120736 ÷ 3

⇒ Volume ≈ 40245.33 cm³

**∴ The approximate volume of metal used is 40245.33 cm³.**
